params.allowedTargets: Allowlisted venues; configured on the vault via `setLine` after deploy.
params.allowedTokens: Allowlisted swap outputs; configured on the vault via `setLine` after deploy.

approveCap(bytes32).notice: One side signs the currently stored hash.

clearRecall().notice: Clear an expired (or unset) recall clock. Required before unpausing.

deposit(uint256).notice: Lender funds the line pot. USDC stays on this contract until drawn.

draw(uint256).notice: Borrower draws USDC from the pot into the vault. Never to an EOA.

executeCap(uint256,uint256,bytes32).notice: Reveal `newCap`. Requires both approvals, matching hash, and `newCap >= drawn`.

onRepay(uint256).notice: Vault-only hook after USDC has been transferred back to the pot.

pauseDraws().notice: Freeze new draws. Does not block repay.

proposeCap(bytes32).notice: Store a hash only. Does not store or emit `newCap`.

recallActive().notice: True once panic / venue-pause has started a recall, including after the deadline.

setVenuePaused(address,bool).notice: Demo stand-in for "Morpho market paused". `true` also starts recall.

unpauseDraws().notice: Unpause draws. Forbidden while a recall deadline is still set.
